report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; metrics show /v1/checkout 200s with zero 502s and p95 ~247ms. Traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, order, postgres, redis) with pool size 1 and 1 idle. No error, saturation, or latency anomaly is established, so no taxonomy cause is supported.

Connection pool saturation metrics (pool size vs. active/waiting) to substantiate db-pool-exhaustion
